independentAnswer.derivation: 4^(1/m) * 2^(1/n) = 2^(2/m + 1/n) = 2^(1/2), so 2/m + 1/n = 1/2. Multiplying by 2mn gives mn - 2m - 4n = 0, hence (m - 4)(n - 2) = 8. Since n >= 2 and the right side is positive, n > 2 and m > 4. Positive factor pairs (m-4,n-2) of 8 are (1,8),(2,4),(4,2),(8,1), giving (m,n)=(5,10),(6,6),(8,4),(12,3). Thus m-n values are -5,0,4,9; the minimum is -5, matching choice 1.
independentAnswer.existenceAndCardinality: Exactly four admissible ordered pairs (m,n), all with integer m,n >= 2; each appears in the factor-pair enumeration.
independentAnswer.choiceCheck: Choices are -5,-3,0,4,9. -5 is present and uniquely equals the minimum; -3 is not attained; 0,4,9 are attained but are not minima.
